sections.Profile:
"Black Magic" is a solid-state pinball machine released by Recel S.A. in 1980. The game accommodates up to four players and features two flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, two sets of three-bank drop targets, four standup targets, two messenger balls, and a spinning target.

- Manufacturer: Recel S. A.
- Years made: 1980
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 1
- Tags: Mystical, Single Player, Magic, Original Theme, Solid State, Fantasy, 1980s
